dedupe_keys.name: puntos de recarga electricos de espana

description: Puntos de recarga eléctricos de España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Electric recharging points are published the fuel prices of petrol stations and the location of electric recharging points in the national territory. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging points in Spain" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Its keywords include Puntos de recarga eléctricos, Vehículos, Energía, Geoportal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
